mentions.claim_text: He recalls an earlier word about people being made to want electric cars in the days ahead, and wonders aloud whether it was about America or about Russia.
mentions.quote: how they'll make people want the electric cars in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A policy or fuel shortage that pushes drivers toward electric cars, in either country he names.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such push in either country. He leaves the country open, which doubles the ways it can be counted a hit and should hold any verdict down.

mentions.claim_text: Flagging it as his own speculation rather than a word, he wonders whether Russia's power grid will be hit next, its power plants struck, leaving the country without power.
mentions.quote: I mean, just me talking if the plan is always about their military
mentions.falsify_match: Ukrainian strikes moving from refineries to Russian power plants and grid infrastructure.
mentions.falsify_miss: Strikes stay on fuel and military targets. He labels this just me talking, so it should not be scored as a word either way.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw lines of cars, of people trying to get fuel.
mentions.quote: I saw lines of cars
mentions.falsify_match: Long fuel queues reported, in Russia in the current context.
mentions.falsify_miss: No queues reported. Base rate note: Russian fuel queues were already in the headlines he had just read out, so this is description more than forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said Turkey will not abandon Syria or let Israel draw a red line, and that Turkey and Syria will come together even to defend Russia in the days ahead, adding that both of the named leaders are evil.
mentions.quote: They will come together even to defend Russia
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey and Syria acting together in Russia's defence, diplomatically or militarily.
mentions.falsify_miss: Turkey or Syria breaks with Russia, or Turkey abandons Syria. The evil verdict on the two leaders is unfalsifiable and is not part of the scoreable claim.

mentions.claim_text: He notes that five doomsday planes are flying at one time and prays that they find what they are looking for.
mentions.quote: Five doomsday planes are going off at one time
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: an observation about aircraft already in the air, not a forecast.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail as stated; it reports something he says is happening now.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a dirty thing up in the northeast, very serious, a yellow fog that went off inside a building, which he calls a tactical thing.
mentions.quote: I saw a dirty thing up northeast
mentions.condition_text: they are praying against it and against the hidden cells
mentions.falsify_match: A radiological or chemical release inside a building in the northeastern United States.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such release in the northeast. He attaches prayer to it, which he elsewhere uses to explain a non-event, so a miss should not be read as prayer answered without him saying so.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are praying against hidden cells inside the nation.
mentions.quote: we're praying against these hidden cells in our nation
mentions.falsify_match: A terror cell already inside the United States being uncovered and charged.
mentions.falsify_miss: No cell found. Base rate note: domestic terror arrests happen every year, so only a network matching what he describes would count.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw lead encasing in Cuba, inside a mountain, and that the Lord said cold alliances, cold war alliances, calling for heightened alert.
mentions.quote: I saw encasing lead in Cuba. It's in a mountain
mentions.falsify_match: A shielded or hardened site inside a Cuban mountain being identified publicly.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such site reported. The claim is about something hidden by design, which makes absence of evidence hard to read as refutation.

mentions.claim_text: Reading a report of a magnitude 5.0 in northern California near San Francisco, he asks whether this is the one the Lord spoke of and repeats that quakes are going to start upticking, tying it to the San Francisco and Portland word.
mentions.quote: He said it's going to start up ticking
mentions.falsify_match: A rising count of magnitude 5 and above quakes on the American west coast over the following months.
mentions.falsify_miss: Quake counts stay flat. Base rate note: he himself is unsure the 5.0 counts, and magnitude 5 events in northern California are ordinary, so this reading is weak on its own terms.

mentions.claim_text: He says he still feels something major is about to happen and has an urgency inside himself.
mentions.quote: I still feel that we're about to see something major
mentions.falsify_match: No criterion is given; something major is undefined.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable as stated, and recorded as such rather than left out.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Venezuela again with battleships all around it, and that the Lord said this is more than drug trafficking: it is a front meant to cause a pause in the BRICS system, because BRICS had been reaching out to Venezuela.
mentions.quote: I saw battleships all around Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: BRICS oil expansion stalling as a consequence of the American move on Venezuela.
mentions.falsify_miss: BRICS continues to add oil producers regardless. The battleship half was already visible when he said it, so only the BRICS pause is forward-looking.

mentions.claim_text: He says Russia, China and others had been reaching out to Venezuela and to Saudi Arabia for oil because they needed those resources to back and strengthen BRICS, and that the American move keeps the dollar's face safe for this season.
mentions.quote: they needed oil economic resources to back the bricks
mentions.falsify_match: Reported BRICS approaches to Venezuela and Saudi Arabia for oil backing, and the dollar holding through the season.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such approaches, or the dollar falls anyway during the season.

mentions.claim_text: He says he keeps seeing that the Venezuelan leader will be like a Saddam, and that the Lord told him it is not all about drugs, ten percent, but ninety percent about the oil.
mentions.quote: I keep seeing he will be like a Saddam
mentions.falsify_match: The Venezuelan leader ending as Saddam Hussein did: removed by force, captured or killed.
mentions.falsify_miss: He stays in power or leaves by negotiation. Clean either-way test.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a Gaddafi-like or Saddam-like man being overthrown in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: in the days ahead becoming overthrown
mentions.falsify_match: The Venezuelan leader overthrown, on the Gaddafi or Saddam pattern.
mentions.falsify_miss: He remains in power through the period. Adds a near horizon to the Saddam comparison, which makes it sharper than the earlier tellings.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will be about stabilising the dollar and that the new energy will come out of this.
mentions.quote: it will be about stabilizing the dollar and the new energy
mentions.falsify_match: A new energy source emerging out of the Venezuelan oil move, alongside a steadier dollar.
mentions.falsify_miss: No new energy emerges from it. New energy is left undefined here, though he defines it as a water energy elsewhere in the same video.

mentions.claim_text: Reading a Newsweek headline saying the president was right about Venezuela, he repeats drill baby drill and says major oil and gas is coming.
mentions.quote: We hear drill, baby drill, major uh oil and gas
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable rise in American oil and gas output and investment.
mentions.falsify_miss: Output flattens or falls. Base rate note: drill baby drill was already administration policy, so restating it is not a forecast.

mentions.claim_text: Praying over America, he thanks God for things accelerating with wars and rumours of wars and for the digital golden age that he says is coming.
mentions.quote: with the digital golden age and the things that you've showed me
mentions.falsify_match: A period branded a golden age that is explicitly digital, in currency, identity or markets.
mentions.falsify_miss: No digital golden age materialises. Digital is the new element here against the plain golden age wording used earlier in the same video.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the glorious church will rise up, be bold as a lion and not shrink back or be cowards in this hour.
mentions.quote: we will see the glorious church rise up
mentions.falsify_match: No public criterion; a glorious church rising has no measure he supplies.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable as stated, and recorded as a prayer declaration rather than a forecast.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking over footage of what he calls top brass from the KGB, he says a doomsday weapon is coming, that it is something of vast magnitude, and that they have to protect the Russian homeland.
mentions.quote: You will see a doomsday weapon
mentions.falsify_match: Russia unveiling or using a weapon reported as a doomsday device, such as a nuclear-powered torpedo or cruise missile.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such unveiling. Base rate note: Russia has publicised Poseidon and Burevestnik for years, so a further test would be a continuation, not a new event.

mentions.claim_text: He says that after this happens the European nations look toward America and ask whether it will come in and defend them because of NATO.
mentions.quote: are you going to come in and defend us because of NATO?
mentions.condition_text: after the European attack he has been describing happens
mentions.falsify_match: European members formally invoking NATO Article 5 or publicly demanding American defence after an attack.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such appeal is made, or America is not asked. Conditional on an attack that has not happened, so it cannot fail until the trigger does.
